title: Sunlight-driven fast photo-degradation of Eriochrome Black T dye using highly efficient La-doped Ag3PO4 decorated with ZnS QDs
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23136-23153
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00544F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shabana Bibi, Amna Bashir, Noshabah Tabassum, It Ee Lee, Hafsa Yasmeen, Syed Mustansar Abbas, Qamar Wali, Muhammad Aamir, Chingmai Ko, Imtiaz Ahmad
The La-doped Ag3PO4 coupled with ZnS QDs is successfully synthesized via a hybrid mixing method for the photocatalytic degradation of (EBT) under direct sunlight. The experimental results revealed that 97.84% of EBT is degraded in 120 min of sunlight irradiation.
